title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Namaste, aap kaise hain?
options: Main theek hoon, dhanyavaad.
Main ghar jaa raha hoon.
Mujhe ek chai chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Main theek hoon, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Main bilkul theek hoon.
options: I am absolutely fine.
I am very tired.
I am almost ready.
questions.correctAnswer: I am absolutely fine.

questions.sentence: Kya haal hai?
options: Sab theek hai.
Mujhe bahut bhookh hai.
Main abhi ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Sab theek hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Tum kaise ho?
options: How are you?
Where are you?
Who are you?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you?

questions.sentence: Aur aap kaise hain?
options: Main bhi theek hoon.
Main abhi aa raha hoon.
Mujhe nahi pata hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main bhi theek hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine too.

questions.sentence: Main aaj bahut khush hoon.
options: I am very happy today.
I am very tired today.
I am not well today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Tum kaise ho, dost?
options: Main mast hoon, yaar.
Aap kahan rehte hain?
Yeh chai bahut garam hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main mast hoon, yaar.
questions.translatedSentence: I am doing great, buddy.

questions.sentence: Sab theek nahi hai.
options: Everything is not okay.
Everything is fine here.
Nothing is very difficult.
questions.correctAnswer: Everything is not okay.

questions.sentence: Aap se milkar khushi hui.
options: Mujhe bhi khushi hui.
Main theek nahi hoon.
Mera ghar yahan par hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi khushi hui.
questions.translatedSentence: I am glad to meet you too.

questions.sentence: Suprabhat! Aaiye, andar aaiye.
options: Dhanyavaad, main andar aata hoon.
Nahi, main abhi so raha hoon.
Aap kahan jaa rahe hain?
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyavaad, main andar aata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I will come in.

questions.sentence: Hamare ghar mein aapka swagat hai.
options: Welcome to our home.
Our home is very big.
Come to our home tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: Welcome to our home.

questions.sentence: Baithiye, main abhi chai laata hoon.
options: Shukriya, aap bahut ache hain.
Nahi, aap yahan mat baithiye.
Main roz subah uthta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Shukriya, aap bahut ache hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, you are very kind.

questions.sentence: Main roz subah chai peeta hoon.
options: I drink tea every morning.
I drink tea every night.
I am making tea right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I drink tea every morning.

questions.sentence: Chai loge ya coffee?
options: Main chai loonga, dhanyavaad.
Main subah jaldi uthta hoon.
Aapka ghar bahut door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main chai loonga, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: I will have tea, thank you.

questions.sentence: Suprabhat, aaj mausam bahut achha hai.
options: Good morning, the weather is very nice today.
Good evening, the weather is very bad today.
Good morning, today is a holiday for us.
questions.correctAnswer: Good morning, the weather is very nice today.

questions.sentence: Ab bahut raat ho gayi hai.
options: Haan, shubh raatri!
Haan, suprabhat!
Nahi, abhi subah hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, shubh raatri!
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, good night!

questions.sentence: Shubh raatri, achhe se soiye.
options: Aap bhi aaram se soiye.
Aap subah jaldi aa jaiye.
Main abhi khana bana raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Aap bhi aaram se soiye.
questions.translatedSentence: You sleep well too.

questions.sentence: Shubh raatri, kal subah milte hain.
options: Good night, see you tomorrow morning.
Good morning, see you later today.
Good night, I am going home now.
questions.correctAnswer: Good night, see you tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, kya main yahan baith sakta hoon?
options: Haan, zaroor baithiye.
Nahi, mujhe der ho rahi hai.
Main auto rickshaw se aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, zaroor baithiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, of course, please sit.

questions.sentence: Zara suniye, yeh auto rickshaw khaali hai?
options: Excuse me, is this auto rickshaw free?
Excuse me, where do I find an auto rickshaw?
Excuse me, how much does the auto rickshaw cost?
questions.correctAnswer: Excuse me, is this auto rickshaw free?

questions.sentence: Aapki madad ke liye bahut shukriya.
options: Koi baat nahi, mujhe khushi hui.
Main aapko nahi jaanta hoon.
Mujhe bhi thodi madad chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, mujhe khushi hui.
questions.translatedSentence: Not at all, it was my pleasure.

questions.sentence: Kripya mujhe metro station tak chhod dijiye.
options: Please drop me at the metro station.
Please tell me where the metro station is.
The metro station is very far from here.
questions.correctAnswer: Please drop me at the metro station.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, main der se aaya.
options: Koi baat nahi, aap baithiye.
Haan, aap bahut jaldi aaye hain.
Main abhi ghar jaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, aap baithiye.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, please have a seat.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, mujhe hindi thodi thodi aati hai.
options: Sorry, I know only a little Hindi.
Sorry, I do not know any Hindi at all.
Sorry, I speak Hindi very well.
questions.correctAnswer: Sorry, I know only a little Hindi.

questions.sentence: Kripya mujhe thoda paani dijiye.
options: Ji haan, main abhi laata hoon.
Nahi, mujhe paani nahi chahiye.
Yeh paani bahut thanda hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, main abhi laata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will bring it right away.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, maine galti se aapka bag utha liya.
options: Koi baat nahi, aisa ho jaata hai.
Dhanyavaad, aap bahut ache hain.
Haan, mera bag bilkul naya hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, aisa ho jaata hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, these things happen.

questions.sentence: Aapka bahut bahut dhanyavaad.
options: Thank you so much.
You are most welcome.
Sorry for the trouble.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you so much.

questions.sentence: Achha, ab main chalta hoon.
options: Theek hai, phir milenge.
Haan, aap andar aa jaiye.
Nahi, main abhi abhi aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, phir milenge.
questions.translatedSentence: Alright, we will meet again.

questions.sentence: Main ab chalta hoon, mujhe der ho rahi hai.
options: I will leave now, I am getting late.
I will come now, I am not late at all.
I am leaving tomorrow, so do not be late.
questions.correctAnswer: I will leave now, I am getting late.

questions.sentence: Kal phir milte hain, theek hai?
options: Haan, kal shaam ko milte hain.
Nahi, main kal yahan aaya tha.
Main aapko bilkul nahi jaanta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, kal shaam ko milte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, let us meet tomorrow evening.

questions.sentence: Phir milenge, apna khayal rakhiye.
options: See you again, take care of yourself.
We met yesterday, do not worry about it.
See you tomorrow, please call me once.
questions.correctAnswer: See you again, take care of yourself.

questions.sentence: Apna khayal rakhna, dost.
options: Tum bhi apna khayal rakhna.
Tum aajkal kahan rehte ho?
Main abhi khana khaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Tum bhi apna khayal rakhna.
questions.translatedSentence: You take care of yourself too.

questions.sentence: Shaam ko milte hain, main auto rickshaw se aaunga.
options: Let us meet in the evening, I will come by auto rickshaw.
Let us meet in the morning, I will come by metro.
I met him in the evening near the auto rickshaw stand.
questions.correctAnswer: Let us meet in the evening, I will come by auto rickshaw.

questions.sentence: Ghar pahunch kar phone kar dena.
options: Theek hai, main phone karunga.
Nahi, mera ghar door nahi hai.
Haan, mujhe naya phone chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, main phone karunga.
questions.translatedSentence: Okay, I will call you.

questions.sentence: Namaste, phir kabhi milenge.
options: Namaste, aapse milkar achha laga.
Namaste, aap andar aa jaiye.
Namaste, main abhi so raha tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Namaste, aapse milkar achha laga.
questions.translatedSentence: Goodbye, it was nice meeting you.

questions.sentence: Ghar par sabko mera namaste kehna.
options: Say hello to everyone at home from me.
Tell everyone at home that I am leaving.
Everyone at home said hello to me.
questions.correctAnswer: Say hello to everyone at home from me.

questions.sentence: Beta, tum kahan rehte ho?
options: Ji, main Lucknow mein rehta hoon.
Ji, aap Lucknow mein rehte hain.
Haan, tum yahan pass mein rehte ho.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji, main Lucknow mein rehta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I live in Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Bade logon se hamesha aap kehna chahiye.
options: You should always say aap to elders.
You should always speak quietly at home.
Elders always speak politely to us.
questions.correctAnswer: You should always say aap to elders.

questions.sentence: Namaste aunty, aap kaisi hain?
options: Main theek hoon beta, tum sunao.
Main bhi aunty ko namaste kehta hoon.
Aunty abhi ghar par nahi hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Main theek hoon beta, tum sunao.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, dear, tell me how you are.

questions.sentence: Agar aap bura na maanein, to main aapse ek sawaal poochunga.
options: If you do not mind, I will ask you a question.
If you have some time, I will call you later.
I asked him a question, but he did not mind it.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not mind, I will ask you a question.

questions.sentence: Kya main aapse ek baat pooch sakta hoon?
options: Ji haan, zaroor poochiye.
Ji nahi, mujhe kuch pata nahi hai.
Haan, main aapse baad mein poochunga.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, zaroor poochiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, please ask.

questions.sentence: Uncle ji, kya main aapki madad kar sakta hoon?
options: Uncle, may I help you?
Uncle, can you help me please?
Uncle, do you need an auto rickshaw?
questions.correctAnswer: Uncle, may I help you?

questions.sentence: Dadaji ko pranam karo.
options: Pranam dadaji, aap kaise hain?
Pranam dadaji, tum kaise ho?
Namaste dadaji, main ab chalta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Pranam dadaji, aap kaise hain?
questions.translatedSentence: Greetings grandfather, how are you?

questions.sentence: Beta, aap mujhe tum keh sakte ho.
options: Nahi, aap mujhse bahut bade hain.
Haan, main aapse bahut bada hoon.
Nahi, main aapko bilkul nahi jaanta.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, aap mujhse bahut bade hain.
questions.translatedSentence: No, you are much older than me.

questions.sentence: Dost ke saath tum theek hai, lekin teacher se aap kehna chahiye.
options: Tum is fine with a friend, but you should say aap to a teacher.
Aap is fine with a friend, but you should say tum to a teacher.
You should say tum to a friend and to a teacher as well.
questions.correctAnswer: Tum is fine with a friend, but you should say aap to a teacher.

questions.sentence: Arre, aap kitne saalon baad mile hain!
options: Haan, poore paanch saal ho gaye.
Haan, main kal hi Delhi aaya tha.
Nahi, hum log roz hi milte hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, poore paanch saal ho gaye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it has been a full five years.

questions.sentence: Bahut din ho gaye, aap kahan the?
options: It has been a long time, where were you?
It has been a long day, where are you going?
It was many days ago, where did you go?
questions.correctAnswer: It has been a long time, where were you?

questions.sentence: Aap aajkal kya kar rahe hain?
options: Main Jaipur mein ek school mein padhata hoon.
Main pichhle saal Jaipur gaya tha.
Mujhe Jaipur ka khana bahut pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Jaipur mein ek school mein padhata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I teach at a school in Jaipur these days.

questions.sentence: Main Delhi chala gaya tha, isliye hum mil nahi paaye.
options: I had moved to Delhi, so we could not meet.
I am going to Delhi, so we cannot meet now.
I went to Delhi because we could not meet.
questions.correctAnswer: I had moved to Delhi, so we could not meet.

questions.sentence: Ghar par sab kaise hain?
options: Sab theek hain, bas papa ki tabiyat thodi kharab hai.
Ghar bahut bada hai, lekin station se thoda door hai.
Main ghar par akela rehta hoon, isliye khana banata hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Sab theek hain, bas papa ki tabiyat thodi kharab hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone is fine, only my father is a little unwell.

questions.sentence: Agar aapke paas thoda time ho, to samosa khaate hain.
options: If you have a little time, let us have a samosa.
If I get a little time, I will bring some samosas.
You had some time, so we ate samosas together.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have a little time, let us have a samosa.

questions.sentence: Chalo, kabhi ghar aaiye, saath mein chai peete hain.
options: Zaroor aaunga, agle hafte time nikaalta hoon.
Mujhe chai bilkul pasand nahi hai.
Main abhi chai bana raha hoon, aap baithiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Zaroor aaunga, agle hafte time nikaalta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I will definitely come, I will make time next week.

questions.sentence: Aapko dekh kar bahut achha laga.
options: Mujhe bhi, hum itne samay baad mile hain.
Mujhe bhi, main kal subah phir aaunga.
Haan, lekin main aapko dekh nahi paaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi, hum itne samay baad mile hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Me too, we are meeting after such a long time.

questions.sentence: Mujhe abhi nikalna hai, lekin agli baar hum lambi baat karenge.
options: I have to leave now, but next time we will talk longer.
I want to leave now because we have talked for too long.
I will leave next time, but today we can talk longer.
questions.correctAnswer: I have to leave now, but next time we will talk longer.
